# LunarTravel implementation notes

- Read `.github/project-memory.md` before project work that depends on prior decisions, current blockers, or next actions. Update it when project state materially changes; keep it concise and never store secrets.
- Keep the LunarTravel visual language editorial, spacious, and restrained.
- Use the supplied assets from the Lunar reference folder before generating new imagery.
- Do not reintroduce video into the hero; use still imagery only.
- Preserve the homepage section order and dedicated `/fleet`, `/coverage`, and `/enquire` routes.
- Validate responsive layout, keyboard access, form labels, alt text, and reduced motion before shipping.
